picks.title: Even Realities G2 review: Smart glasses, stupid controls
picks.excerpt: Even Realities makes one of the best smart glasses on the market, but controlling its growing feature set is harder than it should be.
picks.rationale: Fresh hands-on review of a leading display-glasses product; the controls critique is a concrete interaction-design lesson for AI wearables.

picks.title: People are using AI to make their smart TVs dumb again
picks.excerpt: Fed up with ads, tracking, and sluggish interfaces, some smart TV owners are turning to AI agents to strip away bloatware and take back control of their TVs.
picks.rationale: Novel user-side trend: AI agents used to strip ads and bloat from TV interfaces, a direct signal about how people push back on smart-device UX.

picks.title: I thought the Pixel 11's Magic Capture would be perfect for concerts. I was wrong
picks.excerpt: Magic Capture is great, but only under certain circumstances.
picks.rationale: Real-world test of a Pixel 11 AI camera feature that has not been covered before, showing where it works and where it breaks.

picks.title: Apple's next HomeView could debut as soon as next year with a robotic arm: report
picks.excerpt: Apple just announced its long awaited smart home display: HomeView, and it's available for $299. That said, the product has...
picks.rationale: New report on a different, future product (a robotic-arm HomeView successor), not a rehash of the 10-14 launch; the only HomeView item kept.

picks.title: AI lab offers free plumbing and HVAC repairs across three cities to train AI robots
picks.excerpt: Is AI coming for blue-collar jobs, too?
picks.rationale: Unusual robotics data-collection program using wearable sensors on tradespeople; adds a robotics angle for category spread.
